demo.program:
# Zig — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Zig?", "Andrew Kelley"),
    ("What paradigm is Zig?", "procedural"),
    ("What is creator?", "Andrew Kelley"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "2016"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "procedural"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".zig"),
    ("What is hello world?", "std.debug.print(\"Hello, world!\\n\", .{});"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
